Load provider player id aliases (MBB / NBA) from the data repo

Source: R/load_groups.R
load_mbb_player_aliases.Rd

Loads every player id another source uses for an ESPN athlete, with the ESPN team the athlete was on and the seasons the id held. Use it to map an NCAA (stats.ncaa.org), Fox, Yahoo, KenPom or NBA Stats player id onto the ESPN athlete_id. stats.ncaa.org roster ids are new every season, so an NCAA player has one row per season. Unmatched provider ids are not included. load_mbb_player_aliases() reads the mbb_groups release tag and load_nba_player_aliases() the nba_groups tag.

See load_mbb_team_aliases() for team ids and names.

Usage

load_mbb_player_aliases(..., dbConnection = NULL, tablename = NULL)

load_nba_player_aliases(..., dbConnection = NULL, tablename = NULL)

Source

The mbb_groups release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/mbb_groups.

The nba_groups release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_groups.

Arguments

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player alias.

col_nametypesdescription
leaguecharacterLeague key: mbb or nba.
athlete_idcharacterESPN athlete id.
athlete_id_sourcecharacterId system of athlete_id: espn.
sourcecharacterSource of the player id: ncaa, fox, yahoo or kenpom (MBB); nba_stats, fox or yahoo (NBA).
source_player_idcharacterThe source's own player id (e.g. nba.p.5637, 76284).
team_idcharacterESPN team id of the team the athlete was on when matched.
source_team_idcharacterThe source's own team id when it gives one (the season's stats.ncaa.org team id), else NA.
valid_fromintegerFirst season (ending year) the id is on that team, inclusive.
valid_tointegerLast season (ending year) the id is on that team, inclusive; a gap or a change of match method splits the window into two rows.
match_methodcharacterHow the id was matched: the source leg's own method (exact_name, fuzzy_jw; NCAA name_jersey, name, last_jersey, jaro_winkler), crosswalk (a leg that names none), propagated (carried from the same id's match in another season) or override (a hand-verified fix).
match_confidencenumericThe leg's own confidence where it gives one (the lowest in the window; NCAA tiers score 1, 0.95, 0.9 and 0.85), else NA.
evidencecharacterThe asset or file the row came from.

NULL instead, after appending the rows to tablename, when dbConnection and tablename are both given.

See also

Other Conference and Division Group loader functions: load_mbb_group_aliases(), load_mbb_group_seasons(), load_mbb_groups(), load_mbb_team_aliases(), load_mbb_team_group_seasons()

Author

Saiem Gilani
